system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Analyzes reported symptoms and returns pest/disease diagnosis with confidence level ('low', 'medium', 'high'). Here are my details: my issue_report_id is dummy_issue_report_id_6860.

function.name: atma_diagnose_pest_disease
function.description: Analyzes reported symptoms and returns pest/disease diagnosis with confidence level ('low', 'medium', 'high'). Issue must be reported first. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide treatment — use atma_get_fertilizer_recommendation. May return multiple possible diagnoses if confidence is low. Fails if no issue is reported or symptoms are insufficient.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
